pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Princess Bubblegum standing in a fairy village, holding a heart-topped wand and waving among spotted mushroom houses, flowers, and curling footpaths. A small bridge crosses the stream behind her, with mountains in the distance. Her dress has broad open panels, while windows, roof spots, and tiny garden details fill the surrounding coloring sheet.
